items.t: Amprius Technologies (AMPX) Lifted Its 2026 Outlook, Is It A Bargain?
items.sum: Amprius Technologies (AMPX) just paired a fresh revenue outlook of US$145 million for 2026 with third quarter results that showed higher sales and a smaller loss than a year earlier. The guidance update came after a choppy spell for Amprius Technologies’ stock, with a 7 day share price return of 11.3% following a 90 day decline of 33.1%. items.t: Amprius Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Margin Push and U.S. Expansion
items.sum: AMPX raises its 2026 revenue outlook to $145M, targets stronger margins and expands U.S. battery production despite higher costs and execution challenges.

items.t: B. Riley Securities Maintains Buy on Amprius Technologies, Lowers Price Target to $16
items.sum: B. Riley Securities analyst Ryan Pfingst maintains Amprius Technologies (NYSE:AMPX) with a Buy and lowers the price target from $22 to $16.
Freight costs weighed on margins even as revenue set a record and guidance rose.
